_: Eccrine sweat: a dilute salt solution (99 % water; NaCl ~10-90 mmol/L, hypotonic to plasma; pH ~4.5-7) secreted onto the skin. Numbers at skin temperature 32-35 C. Built from water.variants.sweat plus research; apocrine (axillary, lipid/protein-rich, viscous) secretion is a state. World lane 2026-11-07.

alpha.src: a free liquid surface; on skin the film follows the relief (pores, furrows)

absorption.v: clear; water-like absorption (negligible at mm scale in the visible)
absorption.src: GAPS 5 water mu_a < 1 per m in 400-700 nm

scattering_length_mm.src: not found: no scatterers resolved; clear film

surface_tension_mN_m.src: SONNER15 via GAPS 7 (table value in a review)

viscosity_mPa_s.src: water-like at 32-37 C (IAPWS); no sweat measurement found (GAPS 7)

sodium_mmol_L.src: BAKER17 re-read 11-08 (PMC5371639): local (forearm patch) sweat [Na+] typically ~10 to ~90 mmol/L; predicted whole-body ~10-70; no numeric mean stated in the text

whole_body_L_h.src: SKINMOIST E5 for rest and light-moderate; BAKER17 re-read 11-08: whole-body sweating rate typically ~0.5-2.0 L/h, > 3.0 L/h rare (~2 % of athletes); the hard_exercise_heat [1.5, 2.5] split is E (not stated as such in Baker)

onset_min.src: SKINMOIST T1 (forehead, passive heating, single subject); emergence 'porewise' in pores first (T2)

drying.v: film unobservable 5-10 min after cooling; salt residue left on evaporation (a faint white crust after heavy sweating)

friction_effect.v: moist sweating skin has higher friction against dry counterfaces than dry skin (grip rises, then falls when dripping wet)

v.film_on_surface: the film's own thickness (layers / film values)

collision_thickness_mm.src: ANON_E solver convention: a liquid has no skin of its own; it keeps a no-penetration boundary at solids

model.v: incompressible: no stiffness ramp; a pressure projection (or weakly compressible SPH with numerical sound speed >= 10x the max flow speed) keeps it out of solids and out of itself
model.src: bulk modulus (water 2.2 GPa: effectively incompressible at body speeds)

boundary_wetting.v: the contact angle per pair (pairs/world.json wetting) sets the meniscus at a solid

restitution.src: RICHARD02 / DEGENNES04: drops stick and spread on wettable solids; bounce only on (super)hydrophobic ones

response_time_ms.src: RICHARD02 tau = 2.6 sqrt(rho R^3/gamma) with rho 1003, gamma 0.0718 N/m

wave_speed_m_s.src: sound ~ water's (CRC; oils ~1450); capillary-wave phase speed sqrt(2 pi gamma/(rho lambda)) at lambda 1 mm

damping_ratio.v: viscous: set by viscosity_mPa_s (no separate damping)

effusivity.src: sqrt(k rho c) with the values above

apocrine.src: SKINMOIST M5: apocrine secretion viscous, lipid-rich (axilla, areola and other apocrine sites); no viscosity number found

dried_salt.src: ANON_E: salt microcrystals roughen the surface; read from photos

SONNER15.cite: Sonner Z et al. Biomicrofluidics 9:031301 (2015) PMC4433483 (via GAPS 7)
SONNER15.lic: PMC, licence not read; number used as fact

GERHARDT08.lic: (c) The Royal Society; numbers used as facts
